evidence.why: Premium unlock decision is made from local RevenueCat CustomerInfo on-device, not from a server-authoritative response.
Backend call only reports the client-derived status one-way; it does not fetch/validate an authoritative entitlement and the response is never used to gate access (failures silently ignored).
Standalone helper also decides Pro status purely from client-side SDK info.

other_classes_observed: Silent failure swallowing on backend sync errors
